Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) from v2.3.1 to the most recent healthy release, v2.3.0. Rollback verified; service healthy on v2.3.0 with ~0.2% error rate. Follow-up: investigate the root cause of v2.3.1 before any re-deploy attempt.
